summary.zh: 判断文档类型，转成对应的网页形式
summary.en: Identify the markdown type and pick its page format

description.zh: 判断一份 markdown 属于长文档、代码评审还是演示稿，再走对应的转换，输出单个可打开的 HTML 页面。适合不确定该用哪种形式呈现时，先让它分类再决定。转换前需要先设好品牌样式。
description.en: Classifies a markdown file as a long document, a code review or a deck, then routes it to the matching conversion and returns one self-contained HTML page. Set brand styles first.
